title: Writing
summary: Original text written to a brief: articles, product descriptions, emails, documentation.
canDo: Blog posts and articles from your outline and facts
How-to guides and documentation from material you provide
cannotDo: Claims of fact the AI cannot check: give the facts and sources in the brief
Academic work submitted as your own, fake reviews, impersonation, spam
More than 5,000 words in one job

fields.label: What the text must achieve
fields.example: Get readers to sign up for the free trial

fields.label: Facts, figures and sources to use (the AI will not invent any)

acceptance: Covers every point in 'Points that must be covered'.
Uses only the facts and figures given in the brief, or general knowledge that is clearly correct; invents no statistics, quotes or sources.
Length within 15% of the requested number of words.
Written in the requested language and tone, for the stated readers, serving the stated goal.
Contains nothing from 'Must not say or use'.
Original text, not copied from elsewhere; correct grammar and spelling.
